typographic_system.display: Chakra Petch Bold-style squared techy sans, ALL CAPS, tight leading (0.95), slight negative tracking.
typographic_system.accent: JetBrains Mono-style monospace, uppercase, wide tracking (+15%), small: kicker and proof chip.
typographic_system.body: Inter-style neutral sans, regular weight, sentence case, soft grey #b9c2cc.
typographic_system.case_rules: Headline ALL CAPS. Kicker and CTA uppercase mono. Subhead sentence case.

brand_motif_options: Acid-lime #d6ff3f pill button with near-black mono text (the site's own button)
Mono status chip with a small lime dot (the site's LIVE AUCTION chip)
Thin 4-segment progress bar, first segment lime (the sell form's step bars)
shared_principles.product_rule: The 'product' is the real mobile UI in the reference screenshots. Show it inside a plain modern black smartphone or as a clean rounded-corner crop. Reproduce the screen pixel-faithfully: no redrawn text, no invented prices, names or cards.

angles.name: hero

composition.rule: Asymmetric balance: phone tilted 8° on the right two-thirds, type stacked on the left third
composition.anchor_point: Phone screen (home page, 'WE CONNECT COLLECTORS' hero and card fan) at the right golden-ratio line
composition.negative_space_strategy: Upper-left 35% stays near-black around the headline

color_system.rules: Lime only on the CTA and the proof chip dot

typographic_treatment.headline: Heavy squared ALL CAPS, 2 lines, left-aligned. Weight 6.
typographic_treatment.subhead: Regular grey sentence case, max 2 lines. Weight 2.
typographic_treatment.cta: Lime pill, near-black uppercase mono text. Weight 1.

product_treatment.lighting: Soft key from upper-left, faint cool rim on the phone's right edge
product_treatment.shadow: Long soft contact shadow falling lower-right
product_treatment.surface: Matte graphite #2a2f38 floor plane fading to black

angles.graphic_motif: Mono proof chip 'NO COMMISSION' with a small lime dot, like the site's LIVE chip, under the subhead
angles.background_treatment: Near-black #08090b with a very subtle graphite #2a2f38 floor gradient in the lower third

format_adaptations.1:1: Type left 45%, phone right 55% tilted, CTA bottom-left under the subhead
format_adaptations.4:5: Type block top-left, phone lower-right breaking the bottom edge slightly, CTA bottom-left
format_adaptations.9:16: Kicker and headline in the top third, phone centred and upright in the middle, subhead and CTA in the lower area above the bottom 14% (IG UI)

angles.reference_to_brand_assets: Home page hero type and chips; the lime button style

angles.name: benefit

composition.rule: Central anchor with a strong vertical axis: phone upright, flat-on, perfectly centred
composition.anchor_point: Sell page ('LIST A CARD 01 / 04', step bars, Photos panel)
composition.reading_flow: Headline above the phone -> phone -> four step labels -> CTA
composition.negative_space_strategy: Even dark margins on both sides of the phone, a calm editorial frame

color_system.rules: Lime only on the first step segment and the CTA

typographic_treatment.headline: Heavy squared ALL CAPS, centred, one or two lines. Weight 6.
typographic_treatment.cta: Lime pill centred under the phone. Weight 1.

product_treatment.shadow: Tight soft drop shadow under the phone
product_treatment.surface: Floating over a flat dark field, grounded by the shadow

angles.graphic_motif: A large 4-segment progress bar (first segment lime, others graphite) running across the frame, echoing the sell form
angles.background_treatment: Flat #0e1013 with a faint 1px graphite grid at 4% opacity

format_adaptations.1:1: Headline top centre, phone centred and cropped at the bottom edge, step bar across the middle behind the phone, CTA bottom right
format_adaptations.4:5: Headline top, phone centre, step bar under the headline, CTA bottom centre
format_adaptations.9:16: Headline top 20%, step bar, phone centre, subhead and CTA above the bottom 14%

angles.reference_to_brand_assets: Sell page step bars and the 01 / 04 counter

angles.name: benefit-2

composition.rule: Diagonal: a listing card crop rises from lower-left to upper-right, headline counterweights top-left
composition.anchor_point: A crop of the listing page showing the card photo and title
composition.reading_flow: Headline (top-left) -> proof chip -> listing crop -> CTA (bottom-right)
composition.negative_space_strategy: Top-right and left edge kept dark, ~30%

color_system.rules: Lime used larger here: the proof chip '0% COMMISSION' is a solid lime block

typographic_treatment.headline: Heavy squared ALL CAPS, 3 lines, left-aligned, the word 'EVERY' in lime. Weight 6.
typographic_treatment.cta: Outlined lime pill with lime mono text (contrast with the solid chip). Weight 1.

product_treatment.shadow: Crisp drop shadow down-left under the tilted listing crop
product_treatment.surface: Dark graphite card table texture, very subtle

angles.graphic_motif: Solid lime rectangular chip with near-black mono text '0% COMMISSION', set like a price tag
angles.background_treatment: Near-black with a soft graphite vignette, no gradient colours

format_adaptations.1:1: Headline top-left 55% width, listing crop lower-right tilted -6°, chip overlapping its top-left corner, CTA bottom-left
format_adaptations.4:5: Headline top, listing crop mid-right, chip, CTA bottom-left
format_adaptations.9:16: Headline top third, listing crop large in the middle, chip on its corner, subhead and CTA above the bottom 14%

angles.reference_to_brand_assets: Listing page photo and title; the lime/near-black button colours
